zipper: A zipper is a device used to join two pieces of cloth for a short amount of time. It usually consists of 2 strips of metal on both pieces of cloth that are then joined together.
zinc: Zinc is a type of metal, (symbol Zn) with an atomic number of 30 on the periodic table.
If you zinc something, you cover it with zinc.
zionist: A Zionist is a person who supports Zionism.
zionism: Zionism is the belief that there should be a Jewish country, especially support for the current Jewish state in Israel.
Zionism is a religion that is practiced by people in parts of Africa and is most popular in Eswatini. It is a mix of Protestantism and Animism.
zip: A zip is a sound made by a small object.
A zip is a short form of zipper.
Is the zip on your coat working.
If something zips somewhere, it move there quickly.
The birds zip from tree to tree.
If you zip something up, you close its zipper.
Zip up your coat before going outside.
zillion: A zillion refers to an extremely large number.
zirconium: Zirconium is a metallic (meaning made of metal) element with an atomic number of 40 and symbol Zr.
zit: Zit is a small red and painful spot on the skin.
Zit is a person that annoys and bothers other people.
zigzag: A zigzag is a line that goes sharp in one way and then to the opposite way.
If something zigzags, it moves or twists in a zigzag manner.
If something moves zigzag, it moves forward, while at the same time going left and right a little.
The drunk headed zigzag across the park.
zig: A zig is a sudden or sharp turn or change of direction.
If a person zigs, they make such a turn.
zinger: A zinger is a or humorous remark or insult.
zing: A zing is a short high-pitched humming sound, it is similar to those made by a bullet or string.
A zing is a witty insult or derogatory remark.
If something zings, it moves very quickly.
If you zing a person, you attack or criticize them with a remark.
zimbabwean: A Zimbabwean is a citizen of Zimbabwe.
Something or someone that is Zimbabwean comes from Zimbabwe.
zimbabwe: Zimbabwe is a country in Eastern Africa. Its official name is the Republic of Zimbabwe.
